## Assembly notes

Inputs: part files B1–B10 (`.superpowers/plan-parts/p2/`), the contract, and spec 5.2–5.7 and 8A. Tasks are renumbered in part order: B1.1–B1.4 → Tasks 1–4, B2 → 5–7, B3 → 8–12, B4.1–B4.3 → 13–15, B4.5 → 16, B5.1–B5.6 → 17–22, B4.4 → 23, B6 → 24–31, B7 → 32–36, B8 → 37–41, B9 → 42–52, B10 → 53–58. All cross-references use the new numbers.

**Order change.** B4.4 (the env `GET /api/v1/gpus` and `GET /api/v1/queue` routes) imports `hypothex.core.gpus` (B5.1) and `hypothex.core.scheduler` (B5.4). In part order its tests fail with `ModuleNotFoundError`. It is Task 23, directly after Task 22.

**Duplication removed** (one copy kept, the others now call it):

- Fake `ssh`/`scp`: B2 built `tests/fakes/` and B3 built a second pair inline in `test_bootstrap.py`. Kept B2's. Task 5's `fake_ssh.py` honours `HYPOTHEX_FAKE_REMOTE_PATH` (an exact `PATH`, so B3's "uv is off PATH" test still means something), and Task 8's `host` fixture is a thin wrapper over `install_fake_remote` with the same `FakeHost` API (`calls()` now reads the shared JSON log).
- Test isolation: B9.1 put an autouse `isolate_remote` in three `conftest.py` files. It is now one autouse fixture in `tests/conftest.py` from Task 1 Step 0 (moved there in review round 1 from Task 5), so every part is covered from its first red step (a dead `HYPOTHEX_HUB_URL`, a refusing `ssh`/`scp`, no `HYPOTHEX_FAKE_GPUS`, refusing `nvidia-smi`/SLURM stubs on `PATH`). `docker` tests also get the refusing `ssh`/`scp` (a forgotten override fails closed instead of reading `~/.ssh`); `docker_ssh_env` in `tests/docker/conftest.py` puts back the box's isolated wrappers, and the dead hub URL means `hx hosts add` in Task 54 never reaches the user's running hub.
- Sweep engine: B8 built `hypothex.core.sweeps` (launch, cancel, extend, list) and B9.1 built a second engine in `hypothex.mcp.server` (`start_sweep`, `extend_sweep_runs`, `cancel_queued_runs`, `list_sweeps`, `new_sweep_id`, `sweep_path`, `check_sweep_command`, `SweepRunArgs`, `local_launcher`, `local_stopper`) with different rules. Kept B8's (core, spec 7). Task 42 keeps only the hub client, the CLI parsers, and `find_sweep`. `mark_sweep` and `stop_if_queued` moved into `core.sweeps` (Tasks 40, 41). The routes (Task 46), CLI (Task 49), and MCP tools (Task 50) call the core engine; the hub injects a launcher that forwards each run to the host. B8's rules win where they differ: seed-major order, at most 1000 runs, `s-<4 hex>` ids, unknown `{fields}` refused, `{seed}` optional (runs get `$HYPOTHEX_SEED`). Two B9 rules were good and are now in the core: every swept param must appear in the command (Task 40), and a retried `extend` launches only the missing runs of a seed instead of refusing it forever (Task 41). B9's per-run command ids are kept for forwarded runs as `<command_id>:<seed>:<8 hex of params>`, which stays unique on a retried `extend`.
- Background loops: B5.6 ran the scheduler in threads started by `hx serve` (`serve_loops`), B6.8 started the SLURM poller in `hx serve`, and B9.2 ran an async `_scheduler_loop` in the `create_app` lifespan. Now the lifespan runs both: B5.4's `run_scheduler_loop` in a thread (Task 22) and `SlurmPoller` (Task 31). `serve_loops` and `_scheduler_loop` are gone. So in-process env servers in tests, `hx serve`, and env servers that a hub starts all behave the same.
- `hx serve`: B5.6, B6.8, and B9.6 each replaced it. Task 22 adds `--kind` (`resolve_serve_kind`, saved in `environment.json`), Task 47 adds the bound socket and `server.json`, Task 50 the MCP hub URL, Task 51 the demo hosts. One kind check, `check_serve_kind` (`ssh|slurm`, contract 3), serves `hx serve` and `hx service install`.
- `execute_run` keeping executor fields: B1.4 and B5.2 both replaced the same line. Kept B1.4 (Task 4); B5.2's hunk is removed, and its import-block replacement keeps B1.4's `compute_cost` import.
- GPU holders: B4.4's `gpus_with_runs` (running runs only) duplicated B5.1's `gpu_status` (queued and running). Kept `gpu_status`, with an optional `gpus` argument so the route can pass its 10 s cache (Tasks 17, 23). B4.4's `scheduler_of`/`app.state.scheduler` is gone: the scheduler keeps no state in memory.
- Run file listing: B7 asked for a second route `GET /api/v1/runs/{id}/files` with `mtime_ns`. The existing listing of Task 14 (`/files/<folder>`) now carries `mtime_ns`, `RemoteFile` has it (Task 15), and the mirror calls `EnvClient.list_files` (Task 34); B7's private `_RemoteFile` is gone.
- B4.3 re-added `_error_from`, which B4.1 already defines; the second copy is removed (Task 15).
- B7.5 and B9.1 built `SshTarget` from `os.environ` by hand; they now use `SshTarget`'s own defaults (the same variables).
- B6.8's "Reference: `slurm.py` after Task B6.8" (a full second copy of the module) is dropped: the tasks build it, and a copy would go stale.
- The per-part global constraints, review-focus lists, and self-review notes are dropped. Their tests stay in the tasks; the plan-level sections above replace the lists. Each part keeps one short intro with its design decisions.

**Disagreements resolved (by the contract where it speaks):**

- `RunRequest.slurm`: contract 1.6 lists it for `prepare_run`; B6 and B9 used it, but no part added it. Task 18 adds it. `prepare_run` skips the host GPU count when `slurm` is set (a login node has no GPUs), and the SLURM branch of `launch_run` (Task 28) drops `queue`, because a `queue.json` would make the host scheduler start the run locally and make `stop` skip `scancel`. New test: Task 28 `test_queued_slurm_launch_never_waits_in_the_host_queue`. Task 27's helper now builds its request with `slurm=SlurmDefaults()`.
- `SlurmDefaults` validation: B1.2 refuses unsafe values when the model is built, so B6's tests that built unsafe `SlurmDefaults(...)` would fail at collection. They use `model_construct` (Tasks 25, 28); B6's `validate_defaults` stays as a second check.
- Find-text written against phase 1 code: B6.5 (`launch_run`), B6.6 (`_repair_one`), and B6.7 (`stop_run`) are rewritten against Task 21's code. B9.2–B9.10 edits of `create_app`, the lifespan, and `serve` are rewritten against Tasks 22, 31, 44, 47, 50.
- Environment kind: B5.6 saved the kind in `environment.json` but nothing read it, and Task 28 needs `ctx.descriptor.kind == "slurm"` without a server. `load_descriptor` reads it (Task 22).
- `hx hosts add` bootstrap: spec 8A.2 and B10.2/B10.4 expect `hx hosts add --ssh` to probe, install, and start the env server; B9.7 only wrote the file. Task 48 bootstraps (`probe`, `build_wheel`, `install`, `ensure_server(kind=...)`), refuses `--slurm` on a host without `sbatch`, and adds nothing when the bootstrap fails. `hx hosts upgrade` now stops a managed server before it starts the new one (B3's interface note; B9.7 had left the old one running).
- Kind on the host: B10.4 expects a `slurm` descriptor after `hx hosts add --slurm`, but nothing told the host. `ensure_server` takes `kind` (start script variable `HX_KIND`, Task 11), and the hub supervisor passes the host's kind (Task 36).
- `server.json`: B3's start script writes it after reading uvicorn's `Uvicorn running on http://127.0.0.1:<port>` line; B9.6 bound its own socket, which makes uvicorn log `Config.port` (8000), not the real port. Task 47 passes `port=bound` to `uvicorn.Config`, writes `hostname` like the start script, and drops the unused `--managed` option; the start script still marks the servers it starts `managed: true`.
- Host errors: B9.4 handled `httpx.HTTPStatusError`/`httpx.TransportError`, but `EnvClient` raises `EnvRequestError`/`EnvUnreachableError` (Part 4). One handler keeps the host's status and answers 503 when there is no answer (Task 45).
- Cost of mirrored runs: B1.3 said the mirror must call `price_record` with the host's rate; B7 did not, and B9.3's `cost_today_usd` depends on it. Task 34 prices ended runs (`usd_per_gpu_hour` keyword on `mirror_run`/`mirror_event`, an addition to the contract signature), and Task 35 passes `HostSpec.usd_per_gpu_hour`.
- B9.2's test file `tests/api/test_env_routes.py` would have overwritten Tasks 14 and 23's file; it is `tests/api/test_env_launch.py`.

**Review fixes (round 2).** A review of the assembled plan found 23 issues; each is fixed in the task that owns the code:

- Pinned commit (spec 8A.4): `RunFields.commit` (Task 43); the hub always sends `commit = body.commit or head_commit(hub checkout)` with the diff taken against it, also for every sweep run (Tasks 45, 46); `_resolve_commit` accepts only `^[0-9a-fA-F]{4,40}$` (Task 19). `remote_hub` now clones the host checkout through a bare `origin`, so tests can push a commit the host lacks (Task 44); new test Task 45 `test_launch_on_a_host_runs_the_hub_commit_the_host_lacks`.
- SLURM compute nodes never open SQLite: `NodeContext` and `exit.json` (Task 27); the login node publishes the node's `run.yaml` changes as events, index updates, and scores (`sync_node_run`, Task 29).
- Env-server auth on shared hosts: per-start bearer token (`start.sh` → `HYPOTHEX_SERVE_TOKEN` → `server.json` 0600 in a 0700 folder → `ServerInfo.token` → `EnvClient(token=)`); `TokenGuard` and `hx serve --no-auth` (Tasks 8, 11, 13, 16, 36, 47); reuse checks the descriptor's `environment_id` against `<home>/environment.json` (Task 11); the demo hosts use `--no-auth` (Task 51).
- Mirror bandwidth: `logs/*` tails (8 MiB), `offset` appends for append-only files (Tasks 14, 15, 34), one mirror per run per replay batch (Task 35).
- Hub lifecycle: one `Hub` for the server's life; `HubManager` changes one host through `Hub.add_host`/`remove_host`/`connect` (Tasks 35, 44); `Hub.stop` waits for shielded threads (Task 35); `Index.set_cursor` is monotonic (Task 32); sessions close their `EnvClient`s (Task 35); disconnected hosts persist in `<home>/hosts_disabled.json`; a bad `environments.yaml` no longer stops `hx serve` (Task 44).
- Runs of environments no host serves: stop/rerun/reinfer/reeval answer 503 (`forward(remote_only=True)`), `stop_run` never signals another environment's pid (Task 45); `pull` of such a run is 503 (Task 46).
- `pull` safety: `copy_to`/`copy_from` use `scp -s` and refuse unsafe paths, `..`, and paths without a file name (Task 6); `pull_artifact` copies an absolute path only when it is one of the run's artifacts and matches `^/[A-Za-z0-9_.+@/=-]+$` (Task 46).
- `hx_lock`: stale locks are broken only under `DIR.break` after re-reading the owner, by rename (Task 8); new test Task 11 `test_two_hubs_break_a_dead_lock_once`.
- GPU launch without the host lock during `prepare_run`; GPUs taken meanwhile fail the new run (Task 21).
- Reruns keep `gpus_requested` (queued when > 0) and the run's saved SLURM settings (`slurm.json`); env servers remember the last `slurm` block a launch sent (`slurm_defaults.json`) (Task 28).
- Cost on leaderboard rows, the Overview, and `usd_per_gpu_hour` on host rows: new Task 59 (Part 11).
- Host-only projects: the mirror copies the host's `ProjectEntry` (marked `remote_host`) through the new env route (Task 34); host sweeps check the copied config when the hub has no checkout (Task 40).
- Minor: stop marker only after `scancel` worked (Task 30); `test_serve`/`test_service` count (Task 47: 3 + 5 = 8 before this round's 2 new token tests, so `10 passed`); `HostState.kind` accepts `"local"` and the `local` row reads GPUs through the shared `GpuCache` (Tasks 23, 33, 44); `re.fullmatch` for host and project names (Task 2); the refusing `ssh`/`scp` for `docker` tests too, with `docker_ssh_env` restoring the box wrappers (Tasks 5, 53); `hx launch/sweep --host` send `project`, `commit`, `diff` and warn about untracked files (Task 49); `prepare_run` removes its worktree when a later step fails (Task 19); host artifacts get the host's name in the mirror (Task 34).

- 9 (installed hub, R4): `build_wheel` downloads this exact release for a non-checkout hub. `uv pip download` does not exist in uv 0.9.2, so the plan uses `uv tool run --from pip pip download hypothex==<version> --no-deps --only-binary=:all: --dest <staging>`; failure says "run hx from a source checkout or publish this version" (Task 9, tests with a fake `uv`).

**Review round 2.** Codex review 2 (`.superpowers/plan-parts/p2/codex-review-2.md`) and the controller rulings S1–S9. The rulings replace mechanisms instead of patching them; the superseded code and its tests are removed, not kept beside the new ones. Each backend item is fixed in the task that owns the code:

- 1 (isolation starts too late, S1): the fail-closed baseline is session-wide. `pytest_configure` in `tests/conftest.py` (Task 1 Step 0) sets the dead `HYPOTHEX_HUB_URL`, the refusing `HYPOTHEX_SSH`/`HYPOTHEX_SCP`, the refusing `nvidia-smi`/SLURM stubs first on `PATH`, and unsets `HYPOTHEX_FAKE_GPUS` before any test module is imported or any session/module fixture runs; `isolate_remote` repeats it per test. New test `test_module_fixtures_already_run_fail_closed` (a module fixture sees the baseline). Task 57's module fixture `slurm_hub` sets `HYPOTHEX_HUB_URL` itself.
- 3 (run-root symlink, S2): `open_run_path(store, run_dir, rel_path)` opens the store root and walks down to the run folder and the file with `O_NOFOLLOW` (`O_DIRECTORY` for folders) from that trusted descriptor (Task 14). New tests: the run folder itself replaced by a symlink, and swapped mid-request (both the run root and a folder in it).
- 4 (racy lease, S3): the lease, its renewer, and lock stealing are gone. `hx_lock` is an OS lock: `flock` when present, else `python3` `fcntl`, held by a helper process that exits with the script, so the OS drops it when its holder dies; only a host with neither uses a mkdir lock that is broken solely for a provably dead owner on the same host and never for a live or another host's owner (the error names the lock path) (Task 8). The eight lease tests are replaced by thirteen: mode choice, exclusion and release per mode, release when the holder is SIGKILLed (OS modes), and the mkdir rules (dead, recycled, live, other host). Task 11's two-hubs test runs with a mkdir and an OS lock. Verified here also with a `flock(1)` stand-in in the scratch tree, since macOS has no `flock` (those three cases skip there).
- 5 (unowned workload, S4): gated spawn. `execute_run` starts `sh -c 'IFS= read -r _ || exit 97; exec "$@"' hx-gate <command>` with stdin a pipe, saves `child_pid` (`run.started`), and only then writes `go` (Task 18). A supervisor that dies before that leaves a gate that exits 97 without running anything, so repair releases the GPUs safely. New fault test at both points (before `child_pid`, before `go`): the command never runs, the GPUs are held until repair, then released. Phase 1's `_launch_running` helper waits for the command's `ready` line, since `running` is now saved just before the gate opens.
- 6, 7, 9 (SLURM, S5): explicit intent states `pending` → `submitted(job_id)` | `unknown` in the outbox (Task 28). A timeout, a communication error, or no job id is `unknown` (`SubmitUnknownError`, event `run.submit_unknown`), never a rejection. `unknown` (or `pending` with a dead submitter) is resolved only by the unique comment in `squeue` and `sacct`, both filtered by comment (`find_submitted(comment) -> (job, complete)`, Task 26); the run fails and the intent is dropped only when both answered without a match, the submitter is dead, and `SUBMIT_SETTLE_SECONDS` passed (Task 29). `--job-name`, `--comment`, `--output` (and abbreviations) are rejected in `extra` (`reserved_sbatch_option`, Tasks 2, 25). A stop before the job id is known sets `cancel_requested` under the outbox lock that recording a job id also takes; whoever learns the job id cancels it, and the intent stays until then (Tasks 28, 30). The fake `sacct` gained the `Comment` column. New tests: name-alone never matches, `sacct` failing means unknown, rejection vs unknown outcome, an unknown outcome resolved by its comment, failed only when provably absent, a stop during `sbatch`, a stop of an unknown submission whose job appears later.
- 8 (terminal publication, S6): `_end_if_active` (Task 28) replaces `Context.update_run` for every end the login node writes on a SLURM run: under the run lock a run the node already ended gets no write and no event, and the node's actual end is published instead (`_publish_node_end` → `sync_node_run`); the outbox entry goes only after the event of the actual terminal status (Tasks 29, 30, 41). New tests: the node ends during `reconcile` (published `finished`, no `run.lost`), and a stop racing the node's end.
- 10, 11, 12 (mirror, S7): the append/offset path is removed (route `offset`, `fetch_file(offset=)`, `APPEND_OVERLAP_BYTES`, `_append*`, `_Staged`, the in-mirror refetch). Every changed file is fetched whole into a per-run staging folder; only when all fetches succeeded is the run id claimed hub-wide (`<store>/.claims/<run_id>.json`, written under one shared lock and checked against every project of the store) and are the files installed in one pass under the run lock, `run.yaml` after the files, `.mirror.json` last (Tasks 14, 15, 34). One deviation from S7's "rename swap": the install is a pass of whole-file `os.replace`, not one rename of the run folder, because the folder holds its `.lock` (a swap would orphan lock holders); whole-file installs are idempotent, so the next mirror repairs any cut-short install. New tests: an index failure after growth never duplicates bytes (100 + 10 identical bytes), a failed fetch installs nothing (no terminal `run.yaml` next to stale predictions), a claimed id stays owned after a failed index (another project is refused). Log tails stay capped at 8 MiB and are fetched whole.
- 13, 14 (sweeps, S8): membership is derived from the `sweep:<id>` tag; `SweepSpec.run_ids` is removed and `SweepSummary.run_ids` is derived (contract and spec 8A.6 updated). Each (params, seed) has one command id, `run_command_id(environment_id, project, sweep_id, params, seed)` (16 hex of a SHA-256; the hub's environment id and the project are added to S8's inputs so two hubs' `s-xxxx` ids never collide on one host's receipts). Launch, a retried launch, and extend save the definition (new seeds first), then issue every missing (params, seed) with its command id; the local launcher runs inside `EventLog.run_once`, the hub forwards the id to the host's receipts (Tasks 40, 41, 46). `_launched`, `_launch_all`, the "not indexed yet, retry" error, and the "seeds already in sweep" error are gone (extend is idempotent). New tests: a run whose answer was lost (and not mirrored) is never started twice and counts once mirrored; one command id per run on every launch; a multi-seed extend resumed after seed 2 completed and seed 3 half-completed; extend with seeds it has.
- 15 (SIGTERM, S9): `create_app(..., lifespan_context=)` enters the demo hosts in the ASGI lifespan startup and leaves them in its shutdown, inside uvicorn's signal handling; `hx serve` passes `demo_hosts_running` and no longer wraps uvicorn in it (Task 51). New test `test_sigterm_to_hx_serve_stops_the_demo_hosts` sends a real SIGTERM to a real `hx serve`; it fails with the old outer `with` (checked in the scratch tree) and passes now.
- Non-blocking notes: (a) `_recover_starts` finds queue markers on disk, so a run that ended while it waited loses its `queue.json` on the next tick (Task 20, new test); (b) `copy_from` renames an old folder aside to `.<name>.old` next to it and the next `copy_from` puts it back after a crash between the two renames, under a `flock` on the folder (Task 6, new fault test); (c) `run.lost` names SLURM's end state (e.g. `NODE_FAIL`) when `sacct` gave one at either of the two polls (`confirm_gone` now keeps the first poll's record), else neutral wording (Task 29, new test).
- Coordinator alignment: `mirror.run_updated` carries `reason` when the host's event had one (Tasks 34, 35; contract 1.5; test with a SLURM `NODE_FAIL` reason).
